definition: The parcel is represented by its surveyed horizontal footprint only.
The parcel footprint is associated with a terrain, ground, floor, or reference surface.
The parcel has a height, depth, stratum, datum, or vertical relationship description.
The parcel has vertical limits derived from a legal or jurisdictional source.
A 3D solid has been generated from computable inputs.
The parcel has a legally authoritative 3D extent.
